scope:
Bounded larger-PMTU client-qlog diagnostic, prepared only.
Fixed receive65507/GSO1/system allocator; send16384/32768/65507, fresh32workers.
Low-concurrency fixed-n1c1m1t is deliberately distinct from timed64c64m64t.
HTTP/FIN validity and observed convergence are separate results. A configured
ceiling or padded probe alone never proves ordinary application packets reached it.

convergence.near_target_rule: non-PING response STREAM packet >ceiling-128, after client ACK of a ceiling-sized PING+PADDING packet
convergence.proof_limit: Client observations only. ACK transmission is observed, not server reception/internal discovered PMTU state. Source retains ACK-validated discovery. qlog raw.length is QUIC packet bytes, not IP fragment/syscall count.
convergence.time_unit: milliseconds, qlog0.3 relative time from trace reference; event order breaks equal timestamps

measurements.packet_size_scope: qlog raw.length: received1RTT response STREAM QUIC packet bytes; short-header packet is final in UDP datagram; no independent wire capture
